stage0058_03:r_caaab7bad760e16d.text: $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ Communications Room

stage0058_03:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text: $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ Communications Room

stage0058_03:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text: $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ Communications Room

stage0058_03:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text: ～ $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ Communications Room ～

stage0058_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「How did it turn out?」

stage0058_03:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$マーサ$$
「Analyzing the Unicorn data you sent
　revealed a certain fact.」

stage0058_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$マーサ$$
「As I thought, it was the key to Laplace's Box.
　Triggering the NT-D at specific
　coordinates unlocks data in sequence.」

stage0058_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「So you found where the box is?」

stage0058_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$マーサ$$
「For now, all I've confirmed is
　the coordinates for the next
　data release. Sending it now.」

stage0058_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$マーサ$$
「Yes... Luckily, it's right on $c's route.
　Your next mission is to trigger the
　Unicorn's NT-D at this point.」

stage0058_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「W-wait a moment!
　We're being chased by Neo Zeon!」

stage0058_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$マーサ$$
「Really, if Grandfather...if Syam Vist
　had simply told us where the box was,
　none of this would've happened...」

stage0058_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$マーサ$$
「I don't know what Grandfather and
　$$カーディアス$$ were after, but lose the box
　and the Vist Foundation's glory goes too...」

stage0058_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$マーサ$$
「And of course, we can't let
　Neo Zeon seize it either.」

stage0058_03:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$マーサ$$
「Laplace's Box is our lifeline...
　I'm counting on you, my $$アルベルト$$.」

stage0058_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「Laplace's Box...
　Does it really hold enough power
　to overturn the Federation government...」

stage0058_03:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$シン$$
「Mr. $$ディアッカ$$!
　And Mr. $$イザーク$$ too!」

stage0058_03:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$イザーク$$
「It's been a while, $$キラ$$, $$シン$$.」

stage0058_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$キラ$$
「Why are you two on the $$ラー・カイラム$$?」

stage0058_03:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$シン$$
「Don't tell me, you're coming with us...」

stage0058_03:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$ディアッカ$$
「Sorry to disappoint.
　We're just here as messengers,
　not to join up with $c.」

stage0058_03:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$ブライト$$
「To brief us on $$プラント$$'s situation,
　$$ラクス・クライン$$ sent them here.」

stage0058_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$ディアッカ$$
「Before we knew it, both $$イザーク$$ and I
　got pushed out of $$ザフト$$'s mainstream.
　Thanks to that, we get to do stuff like this.」

stage0058_03:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$イザーク$$
「It's no laughing matter, $$ディアッカ$$.
　It means $$プラント$$ is steadily
　marching down the road to war.」

stage0058_03:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$ディアッカ$$
「Miss $$ラクス$$ is doing her best too,
　but the Clyne faction's losing ground in the Council.」

stage0058_03:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$イザーク$$
「Instead, the ones gaining ground
　are the faction that worships 《$$パトリック・ザラ$$》.」

stage0058_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$イザーク$$
「Yeah, that's right.
　In the war against the 《$$地球連合$$》
　before the $$大時空震動$$, he led $$プラント$$.」

stage0058_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$ディアッカ$$
「They say he had his reasons too, but
　$$パトリック・ザラ$$'s ideology of wiping out
　the Naturals is still alive in $$プラント$$.」

stage0058_03:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$ブライト$$
「The ghosts of war, huh...」

stage0058_03:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$ディアッカ$$
「But you know, Captain $$ブライト$$,
　Earth's got 《$$ロゴス$$》's ghosts pulling
　the Federation's strings too. We're even.」

stage0058_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$イザーク$$
「We knew a faction like that existed
　under the surface, of course.」

stage0058_03:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$イザーク$$
「What's frightening is that, without
　a solid leader like $$パトリック・ザラ$$,
　they grew this fast anyway.」

stage0058_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$ディアッカ$$
「$$アスラン$$ and $$ルナマリア$$ are
　looking into what's behind it,
　but it's not going too well, apparently.」

stage0058_03:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$シン$$
「...Anger and hatred might really be
　impossible to erase... But going to war
　over it just repeats the same thing...」

stage0058_03:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$シン$$
「Have you already forgotten...!?
　That people like that dropped 《$$ユニウスセブン$$》
　and caused the $$大時空震動$$!」

stage0058_03:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$ディアッカ$$
「You're right about that, $$シン$$.」

stage0058_03:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$イザーク$$
「The multiverse wasn't born just from
　the 《$$時空震動弾$$》... The energy from
　$$ユニウスセブン$$'s fall triggered it too...」

stage0058_03:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$キラ$$
「So the world we're in now...
　is one built on the outcome of hatred...」

stage0058_03:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$ディアッカ$$
「Don't make that face, $$キラ$$.」

stage0058_03:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$ディアッカ$$
「That's what $$アスラン$$ would've said, anyway.」

stage0058_03:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$ディアッカ$$
「You two have flipped hopeless situations
　like that on their head plenty of times, haven't you?」

stage0058_03:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$イザーク$$
「We'll work with $$ラクス・クライン$$
　to stop $$プラント$$ from marching to war.」

stage0058_03:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$イザーク$$
「So you two do what you need to do too.
　Give it everything you've got.」

stage0058_03:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$シン$$
「Thank you, Mr. $$イザーク$$, Mr. $$ディアッカ$$.」

stage0058_03:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$ディアッカ$$
「No need to thank us.
　We're the ones leaning on you guys anyway.」

stage0058_03:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$シン$$
「But... I'm glad.
　Knowing we're not the only ones fighting.」

stage0058_03:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$ディアッカ$$
「Of course you're not.
　Believe it or not, I'm your great senior here.」

stage0058_03:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$イザーク$$
「Captain $$ブライト$$.
　The detailed situation in $$プラント$$
　is in the data we gave you.」

stage0058_03:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$イザーク$$
「This is strictly personal cooperation,
　and may not reflect all of $$プラント$$'s will,
　but please make use of it.」

stage0058_03:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Thank you for your cooperation.」

stage0058_03:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$イザーク$$
「No...
　We should thank you, for protecting
　$$プラント$$ from the Vajra and Altairan army.」

stage0058_03:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$ディアッカ$$
「See you, $$キラ$$, $$シン$$.
　Say hi to everyone in $c for us.」

stage0058_03:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$キラ$$
「You two take care too, $$ディアッカ$$, $$イザーク$$.」

stage0058_03:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$イザーク$$
「Hmph... I'm not so far gone that
　I need you worrying about me.」

stage0058_03:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$キラ$$
「Hearing you say that puts my mind at ease.」

stage0058_03:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$オードリー$$
「That can't be true.
　What's wrong?」

stage0058_03:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$バナージ$$
「I'm just... a little tired.」

stage0058_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Then go rest in your room.
　We don't know when the launch order will come.」

stage0058_03:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Fight, fight, fight...
　This isn't the time for that...」

stage0058_03:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Even when we fought humanity's enemy,
　$$プラント$$ just stood by and watched...」

stage0058_03:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Even our own Federation people
　just say whatever they want, trying
　to use $c as their tool...」

stage0058_03:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Tell me, Mr. $$カミーユ$$.
　What's the point of doing any of this?」

stage0058_03:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Zeon has its own justice, and
　the Federation has its own justice...
　For one side to force it through, that's...」

stage0058_03:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「You're right, $$バナージ$$.
　War isn't justice striking down evil,
　it's just each side forcing their own.」

stage0058_03:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$バナージ$$
「What's the point of that!?」

stage0058_03:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Even so, I fight because
　I believe it has to be done.」

stage0058_03:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Don't you have that in you?」

stage0058_03:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Was it Palau that set this off?」

stage0058_03:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「I know you and that four-winged pilot
　have connected, heart to heart.」

stage0058_03:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$バナージ$$
「What are you trying to say?
　That I should stop getting cozy with the enemy?」

stage0058_03:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「I have no right to say something like that.」

stage0058_03:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「But I'll say this much.
　Half measures will hurt you both.」

stage0058_03:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「So, $$バナージ$$... don't leave yourself
　with regrets. If you don't want to fight, rest now.」

stage0058_03:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「A plan's been proposed to intercept
　Neo Zeon's pursuit force. The Unicorn
　will be its centerpiece.」

stage0058_03:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Are my mind and $$ハマーン$$'s overlapping...!?」

stage0058_03:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Captain $$クワトロ$$ is here too...
　Is this that man, inside $$ハマーン$$'s mind...!?」

stage0058_03:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「Well done, $$バナージ・リンクス$$!
　Thanks to you, we drove off Neo Zeon!」

stage0058_03:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Mr. $$アルベルト$$... what is Laplace's Box?」

stage0058_03:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$バナージ$$
「The ruins of Laplace, the PM's residence...
　Unicorn's Laplace Program...
　Just what is that, exactly!?」

stage0058_03:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$バナージ$$
「$$フル・フロンタル$$ said the Unicorn
　is the key to Laplace's Box!」

stage0058_03:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$シン$$
「Is that why the Unicorn's being targeted...?」

stage0058_03:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Mr. $$ダグザ$$ died because of
　the fighting over that box!
　I won't stay silent any longer!」

stage0058_03:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$バナージ$$
「What is it, this Laplace's Box!?
　Does it really have power to topple the Federation!?」

stage0058_03:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Does it really hold that much meaning...」

stage0058_03:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「I don't know...!
　I really don't know!」

stage0058_03:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Mr. $$アルベルト$$, let's stop hiding things now.
　The truth is, wars are being fought over that box」

stage0058_03:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Industrial 7, Mr. $$ダグザ$$ too...
　they all became victims of that fight!」

stage0058_03:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「I-I really don't know either!
　My only duty was managing the Unicorn,
　the box's key, nothing more!」

stage0058_03:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「Believe me!
　I'm just being used too!」

stage0058_03:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$アムロ$$
「That's enough, $$バナージ$$.
　It really seems Mr. $$アルベルト$$ doesn't know
　what's inside the box either」

stage0058_03:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$キラ$$
「The power to change the world...
　Laplace's Box...」

stage0058_03:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$シン$$
「What do you mean, its key?」

stage0058_03:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Unicorn's Laplace Program
　pointed to Dakar's coordinates」

stage0058_03:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「When the Unicorn activates NT-D
　at a specific location, info on the box is revealed...」

stage0058_03:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$アムロ$$
「So those Laplace ruins
　were the coordinates in question」

stage0058_03:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「...We've always worked together on the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$...」

stage0058_03:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$コンロイ$$
「Don't underestimate the $$エコーズ$$」

stage0058_03:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「A soldier's duty is to come back alive.
　I've walked through worse than that more than once」

stage0058_03:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「Seems I gave you needless worry, $$バナージ$$」

stage0058_03:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$バナージ$$
「If we could meet again like this,
　then nothing else matters...!」

stage0058_03:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$コンロイ$$
「We recovered the four-winged unit too.
　The pilot's survival is confirmed as well」

stage0058_03:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Ms. $$マリーダ$$ is alive...」

stage0058_03:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$オードリー$$
（$$マリーダ$$... I'm glad you're safe...）

stage0058_03:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$コンロイ$$
「Once the pilot wakes, we'll interrogate her.
　That should tell us how much Neo Zeon knows
　about Laplace's Box」

stage0058_03:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「So... what do you plan to do?
　Beat Neo Zeon to Dakar
　and get the box's next lead?」

stage0058_03:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「What did you say!
　Do you understand your position!」

stage0058_03:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$バナージ$$
「The Unicorn is something I was entrusted
　with by $$カーディアス・ビスト$$」

stage0058_03:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$バナージ$$
「If Laplace's Box is the cause of this fighting,
　then I'll seal the Unicorn away」

stage0058_03:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$バナージ$$
（Now I understand, $$オードリー$$...
　why you came to visit the Vist family's mansion）

stage0058_03:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$$バナージ$$
（And now, I've decided what I have to do）

stage0058_03:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「Argh, this is pointless!
　I'm reporting this to Commander $$ブライト$$!」

stage0058_03:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Please calm down, Mr. $$アルベルト$$.
　The talks with Neo Zeon matter more right now」

stage0058_03:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$コンロイ$$
「Well... we're nominally Federation Forces,
　so even getting material to overthrow
　the Earth Federation wouldn't mean much」

stage0058_03:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「On top of that, depending on how the talks go,
　Laplace's Box may become meaningless
　to Neo Zeon as well」

stage0058_03:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$アムロ$$
「I know.
　This is probably our last chance to learn $$シャア$$'s intent」

stage0058_03:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$アムロ$$
（$$シャア$$... don't make me give up on you）

stage0058_03:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「Well done, $$バナージ・リンクス$$!
　Thanks to you, we drove off Neo Zeon!」

stage0058_03:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Mr. $$アルベルト$$... what is Laplace's Box?」

stage0058_03:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$バナージ$$
「The ruins of Laplace, the PM's residence...
　Unicorn's Laplace Program...
　Just what is that, exactly!?」

stage0058_03:r_0cea115be526a319.text:

「$$フル・フロンタル$$ said the Unicorn

stage0058_03:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$シン$$
「Is that why the Unicorn's being targeted...?」

stage0058_03:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Mr. $$ダグザ$$ died because of
　the fighting over that box!
　I won't stay silent any longer!」

stage0058_03:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$バナージ$$
「What is it, this Laplace's Box!?
　Does it really have power to topple the Federation!?」

stage0058_03:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Does it really hold that much meaning...」

stage0058_03:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「I don't know...!
　I really don't know!」

stage0058_03:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$アムロ$$

stage0058_03:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:

「Industrial 7, Mr. $$ダグザ$$ too...

stage0058_03:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:

stage0058_03:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:

stage0058_03:r_2b93cca10f1c36a8.text:
$$アムロ$$

　It really seems Mr. $$アルベルト$$ doesn't know
　what's inside the box either」

stage0058_03:r_7980fd37141d88d0.text:
$$キラ$$
「The power to change the world...
　Laplace's Box...」

stage0058_03:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$$シン$$
「What do you mean, its key?」

stage0058_03:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Unicorn's Laplace Program
　pointed to Dakar's coordinates」

stage0058_03:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「When the Unicorn activates NT-D
　at a specific location, info on the box is revealed...」

stage0058_03:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$$アムロ$$
「So those Laplace ruins
　were the coordinates in question」

stage0058_03:r_bdc546b199c80996.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「...We've always worked together on the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$...」

stage0058_03:r_9c13714b3efbc7a8.text:
$$コンロイ$$
「Don't make such a pathetic face, $$バナージ$$.
　That's not what the Colonel would want」

stage0058_03:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$コンロイ$$
「The Colonel fulfilled his duty as a soldier」

stage0058_03:r_8a78bcec22029401.text:
$$バナージ$$
「So that's... the responsibility Mr. $$ダグザ$$ spoke of...」

stage0058_03:r_f42017dfce31dea9.text:
$$コンロイ$$
「Ever since Palau, the Colonel had made it
　his own point of pride to see you through.
　Now that it's done, he has no regrets」

stage0058_03:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$バナージ$$
「I can't accept that explanation!」

stage0058_03:r_9e994a4b926d9906.text:
$$コンロイ$$
「You don't have to accept or understand it.
　The Colonel liked that about you」

stage0058_03:r_ffae76d2a77abf5a.text:
$$コンロイ$$
「At the same time, didn't the Colonel also say
　he wouldn't allow his death to stop you」

stage0058_03:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$コンロイ$$
「Mourn the Colonel in your own way.
　But if his death means anything to you,
　then fulfill your own responsibility」

stage0058_03:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
$$コンロイ$$
「We recovered the four-winged unit too.
　The pilot's survival is confirmed as well」

stage0058_03:r_d037ecbc1e348dc9.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Ms. $$マリーダ$$ is... alive...」

stage0058_03:r_bcd53d14c4785426.text:
$$コンロイ$$
「Once the pilot wakes, we'll interrogate her.
　That should tell us how much Neo Zeon knows
　about that Laplace's Box after all」

stage0058_03:r_9ca55ea7feca954a.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「So... what do you plan to do?
　Beat Neo Zeon to Dakar
　and get the box's next lead?」

stage0058_03:r_fa59c6df081e6ae4.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「What did you say!
　Do you understand your position!」

stage0058_03:r_ca3edf3b8b52aedf.text:
$$バナージ$$
「The Unicorn is something I was entrusted
　with by $$カーディアス・ビスト$$」

stage0058_03:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$$バナージ$$
「If Laplace's Box is the cause of this fighting,
　then I'll seal the Unicorn away」

stage0058_03:r_304e98dac43c9333.text:
$$バナージ$$
（Now I understand, $$オードリー$$...
　why you came to visit the Vist family's mansion）

stage0058_03:r_b740d817a14afd3a.text:
$$バナージ$$
（Mr. $$ダグザ$$...
　I've decided what I have to do.
　This is my responsibility... my resolve）

stage0058_03:r_40e4c010d1b35b4c.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「Argh, this is pointless!
　I'm reporting this to Commander $$ブライト$$!」

stage0058_03:r_c33abf00683a32bc.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Please calm down, Mr. $$アルベルト$$.
　The talks with Neo Zeon matter more right now」

stage0058_03:r_3036adce91d1f4a8.text:
$$コンロイ$$
「Nominally, we're Federation Forces.
　Even if we got material to overthrow
　the Earth Federation, it wouldn't matter much.」

stage0058_03:r_019293cb83599509.text:
$$コンロイ$$
「Besides, depending on the talks' outcome,
　Laplace's Box may become meaningless
　to Neo Zeon as well.」

stage0058_03:r_c9016e3ab05470b0.text:
$$アムロ$$
「I know.
　This is probably our last chance to learn $$シャア$$'s intent」

stage0058_03:r_a684e6cea428e518.text:
$$アムロ$$
（$$シャア$$... don't make me give up on you）

stage0058_03:r_7313331f4077d255.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Master $$ダグザ$$, you overturned fate!
　This $$ＡＧ$$ is truly impressed!」

stage0058_03:r_a84ab0c3c1ba44d4.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「Wait, $$ＡＧ$$.
　You make it sound like it was already
　decided that I'd die back there.」

stage0058_03:r_414e6e90094d1413.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「No, no, not at all...!
　I'm just glad to be reunited with
　Master $$ダグザ$$ like this.」

stage0058_03:r_83a9e41e15444c69.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「Knowing you...
　aren't you just glad my surviving
　produced a Z-Chip?」

stage0058_03:r_7b3a37f5039eb1f6.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「So, how much did it come to?
　You said I overturned fate, so it
　must be a hefty sum, right?」

stage0058_03:r_ddd97a6ef823929a.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「Well then, in lieu of a gift,
　have that added to the unit's stock.」

stage0058_03:r_df349052cd9cdd0c.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Understood.
　My, my... quite the sharp one, Master $$ダグザ$$.」

stage0058_03:r_a7ce9f908380694c.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「It's not for nothing I'm back from hell.」

stage0058_03:r_8deea7c70d7a76e7.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You seem nervous ahead of the talks
　with $$シャア・アズナブル$$.」

stage0058_03:r_5d8b67b5bd8ce190.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「They might be aiming for a sneak attack.
　Trying to bury a nemesis who's in the way.」

stage0058_03:r_7cf3c91395139f5c.text:
$$アムロ$$
「That's not it.
　If $$シャア$$ really thought I was in his way,
　he'd just send an assassin.」

stage0058_03:r_6ccd85652ef4ccf1.text:
$$アムロ$$
「That he can't do that is his weakness,
　and why they call him a romantic.」

stage0058_03:r_fbe7bf7d854012a7.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You really believe in
　$$シャア・アズナブル$$, don't you.」

stage0058_03:r_1f438885dbc1359e.text:
$$アムロ$$
「That phrasing feels a bit off.」

stage0058_03:r_78d3b2a75e38d6f7.text:
$$アムロ$$
「'Nemesis' feels oddly embarrassing.
　'Old ties I can't shake' suits us better.」

stage0058_03:r_8d461de418389bf8.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I see, rotten ties, is it...
　Then I'll tell Master $$サザンカ$$ about you two.」

stage0058_03:r_59ce7fd9524ec8be.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Whoops... ahead of something important,
　it's not good to stir up needless trouble.
　I should get back to my duties too.」

stage0058_03:r_33f67c683bda9203.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well then, let's get going today too...
　Business, business!」
